subtitle: Lesson 8 · Provisioning GPU Infrastructure

steps.label: Default model: whole integers only
steps.sub: a request for 1 GPU claims an entire physical card

steps.label: A100s and H100s are enormous
steps.sub: small inference workloads often use a fraction of that

code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nvidia-device-plugin-config
  namespace: kube-system
data:
  config.yaml: |
    version: v1
    sharing:
      timeSlicing:
        resources:
          - name: nvidia.com/gpu
            replicas: 4
caption: 4 pods can now share 1 physical GPU — but with no memory or fault isolation between them.

code:
nvidia-smi -mig 1
nvidia-smi mig -cgi 19,19,19 -C
# profile IDs vary — nvidia-smi mig -lgip lists what's available

# requesting a MIG slice in a pod:
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/mig-1g.10gb: 1
caption: A100/H100-class GPUs only — carves the physical card into isolated GPU instances.

steps.label: Time-slicing
steps.sub: any NVIDIA GPU, simple, no isolation — fine for light/forgiving workloads

steps.label: MIG
steps.sub: supported GPUs only, fixed profiles, real hardware isolation

steps.label: Training still wants a whole GPU
steps.sub: sharing is squarely an inference/multi-tenant concern
